Asia/Shanghai is UTC+8 (historical standard). Europe/London in 1715 would be using local mean time (approx UTC-0:01:15) but for simplicity, treat as UTC+0.  
Offset difference = 0 - 8 = -8 hours.  
2:00 + (-8) = -6 hours → 24 - 6 = 18:00 previous day.  
So May 13, 1715, 18:00 in London.  

FINAL_ANSWER: May 13, 1715, 18:00
